---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a feature
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem you want to solve. What gap
does this feature fill? What use case does it enable?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include details
about how you imagine the feature working — where it lives in the codebase,
what the API surface looks like, or what the user experience should be.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches have you considered? Why are they insufficient?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request
here.
